mapper.sql: SELECT id, email, username, display_name, password_digest, created_at, updated_at FROM users
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows f WHERE f.follower_id = u.id) AS following_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows f WHERE f.followee_id = u.id) AS follower_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follows f WHERE f.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f.followee_id = u.id) AS followed_by_me FROM users u WHERE u.username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, username, display_name, password_digest) VALUES (#{email}, #{username}, #{displayName}, #{passwordDigest})
